title: No test holds that the sync gate and pre-push run selfdoc stale over the pushed range
goal: A test named test_selfdoc_gate_passes_since runs the kbgit gate (or reads its check list) and fails when the selfdoc stale call loses --since <upstream>, so dropping it from kbgit.py no longer leaves the range judgement of ST-qp5wsqab unguarded (SP-ar52y6fk review)
